title: Fun mats but NOT non-slip
text: Fun mats but NOT non-slip. We use these cutting mats as cutting boards and also use a couple for play dough or clay playing. They slip all over the place on my butcher board counters, so I'm not sure why they are considered non-slip. I've tried turning them over, but both sides move all over the place when used as cutting boards. They also always come out of the dishwasher super wet (when everything else is dry) and need to air dry before being put away, as you can't just wipe water off the bumpy side.
